changelog_lines: ### Fixed

- `--bearer` and `--header` with `--stdio` are usage errors, and `$MCP_REVIEW_CHECK_TOKEN` is ignored for stdio targets. An exported CI token no longer marks a stdio run as authenticated and silently turns RT-009 off.
- `--header "Authorization: …"` together with `--bearer`, or a header name given twice in any case, is a usage error. Before, `fetch` sent one merged, invalid value.

- A `--header` name that is not an HTTP token, a `--cwd` that is not an existing directory and an empty `--output` are usage errors (exit 2). Before, they were connect failures (exit 3) or the report went to stdout.
- `--timeout` and `--max-duration` accept whole milliseconds only. `0x10`, `1e2` and `1.5` are usage errors.
- `--active-auth` with `--stdio` is a usage error and no longer prints a DCR notice for a probe that never runs.
- `--stdio "<command>"` with `-- <command> [args...]` says "not both" instead of "expected a single <url>".
- `node dist/cli` without the `.js` extension runs the CLI. Before, it exited 0 without checking anything.
- After SIGINT or SIGTERM, a run that still finishes during the shutdown grace period writes no report. Before, it overwrote `--output` with a report that looked complete.
- The `--output` summary line reads "1 error" and "1 warning" in the singular.
- `--list-rules <prefix> --format markdown` no longer prints an empty rule table or an empty checklist table.
### Changed
- `--target`, `--format` and `--fail-on` accept values in any case, as `--ignore` and `explain` already did.
- `--ignore` accepts a comma-separated list (`--ignore TOOL-006,TOOL-011`).

- `explain` shows what a rule needs to run (`--active`, `--active-auth`, a `<url>` target, a tools listing). For a manual item it shows the feature the item is shown for and the `--ignore` hint. `--list-rules --verbose` prints the needs, and the text listing tags manual items `[ui]` or `[oauth]`.
### Added

- Warnings on stderr when `--tool-args` is given without `--active` or `--sarif-location` without `--format sarif`, and for each `--tool-args` entry that no `--active` call used, with the reason: unknown tool, not read-only, or past the call cap.

changelog_lines: Fixed: A stdio server that writes a flood of lines to stdout no longer crashes the check with a JavaScript heap out-of-memory error: only the first transport errors and the first 50 stray stdout lines are kept, with their counts.
Fixed: SRV-018 reports JSON log lines (pino, winston, bunyan) on stdout, not only lines that are not JSON at all.

Fixed: A stdio server whose handshake fails or is stopped by `--max-duration` now has its stderr and stdout shown: the fatal message names the first stray stdout line, SRV-018 reports it, and `--verbose` prints the stderr.

Fixed: A legacy HTTP+SSE server that requires auth only on `GET /sse` gets the auth probe and "requires auth" coverage instead of "not an MCP endpoint, try /mcp", and an SSE handshake error (an endpoint on another origin) is reported as such.
Fixed: A 401 to credentials passed with `--header` is reported as rejected credentials, not as "server requires OAuth".

Fixed: The auth probe reads the challenge from the 401 the credentials got when the unauthenticated request got a 403 without `WWW-Authenticate`, so false AUTH-002/004/013 errors no longer appear and PRM from the header is found.
Fixed: A server whose initialize is public but whose `tools/list` answers 401 gets the auth probe and "requires auth" coverage instead of SPEC-008/014/020 errors.
Fixed: A server that exits right after initialize no longer passes with a score of 100: the check is marked partial (`list-failed`).
Fixed: stdio messages up to 64 MB are accepted (the SDK default was 10 MB), and a larger one is named as the cause of the "Connection closed" errors that follow.
Fixed: A `--max-duration` deadline that falls while connections close after the last check no longer turns a finished run into INCOMPLETE "during active tool calls".
Fixed: A run stopped by `--max-duration` keeps the JSON-RPC errors and 2026-07-28 results it had observed.

Fixed: The input caps no longer cut names, URIs, regex patterns and other schema syntax at 16 KB, which caused false TOOL-003 duplicates and TOOL-017 "does not compile" errors, a false APPS-019 and skipped APPS checks for long UI URIs.
Changed: A 403 handshake failure names a Cloudflare bot challenge or WAF block (Cloudflare, Akamai, AWS WAF, Imperva) or the HTML page title, with a hint to allow the endpoint.
Changed: A stdio server that announces an HTTP URL on stdout (an HTTP server started with `--stdio`) gets a pointer to check that URL instead.
Changed: The check ends each Streamable HTTP session it opens with `DELETE`, so repeated runs leave no sessions behind on stateful servers.

Changed: The input caps also cover raw list pages, the text-only tools/list, tool call results and 2026-07-28 results, and object keys; at most 50 UI resources are read per run, and the report says when more were listed.

done.summary: Wire probes (GET, badVersion, DELETE, Origin) are sent to the target of a same-host redirect of the preflight. The new sameHostRedirect() in network.ts does not follow a redirect to another host or an https->http downgrade. SRV-006 is still reported from the preflight. The part about discover/era and the auth probe is deferred because it needs connect.ts.

The get probe reuses the answered 'sdk GET' exchange of the same session (sdkSessionGet) instead of sending a second GET, which one-stream-per-session SDK servers answer with 409, giving a false SPEC-005.

wrongTypeValue picks a value outside every allowed type and returns undefined for an untyped, anyOf-only or $ref-only property, or one that allows every type. runActive then skips the invalid-type call, so there is no more false RT-002.

On legacy HTTP+SSE the Origin probes are sent as GETs to the SSE stream (abortAfterHeaders), so SRV-008 sees a local SSE server that accepts a foreign Origin. originProbes now takes a mode (initialize, discover or sse).
callableTools() groups tools by name. A name is called once, and only if every entry with that name passes isSafeToCall.
--tool-args is read by own key, so constructor, __proto__ and toString no longer match prototype members.

Argument synthesis now follows format, minLength/maxLength, minimum/exclusiveMinimum/maximum/multipleOf, minItems, nested required properties, anyOf/oneOf/allOf (first non-null branch), local $ref (depth-limited) and type unions with null. The documented order default -> examples -> enum -> const is kept.

closeProbeSession(): one best-effort DELETE with Mcp-Session-Id after a 2xx on the preflight, the initialize Origin probes and the auth invalid-token probe. It sends no retries and does not send a redacted or malformed id.

Deps.tlsCheck and tlsCheckWithRetry accept {timeoutMs, signal}. The timeout is min(timeoutMs, 10 s), the check aborts on the signal, nothing is retried after the deadline, and a cut-off check is transient (inconclusive). Wiring it into connect.ts is deferred.

prmCandidates deduplicates the header URL against the well-known URLs. Metadata GETs and timing samples wait at most min(--timeout, 10 s), and all metadata GETs of one auth probe share a budget of 6 retries.
